note: Enrolled in v0.60.0. Guard-shaped since it was written and classified `candidate` by BL-101's registry, which is how it became countable. BL-121 was the blocker: 51 checks across these nine suites read a crashed probe as a pass, so a mutation registered here would have been registered against a check that could not fail. That closed in v0.59.0.

mutations.why: Drop the `Not legal advice` footer from the board view. It is one list comprehension away at all times, it reads as tidying, and the artifact that loses it is the one a director forwards to counsel. This suite does not scan renderer SOURCE for vocabulary, so the source-scan mutation the other six use passes here — the anchor had to be found against what this suite actually checks rather than assumed from its siblings.
